name: GitHub
description: Connect a GitHub account to an Engineering OS workspace to browse repositories and pull requests.

permissions.reason: Reads GitHub repositories, pull requests, diffs, and file contents through the GitHub REST API.
Resolves workspace-scoped GitHub credential references from the local secret store.
Stores workspace-scoped GitHub credentials in the local secret store instead of SQLite.
Starts the bundled GitHub MCP server process for repository and pull request tools.
Registers the plugin-owned GitHub MCP server with the application gateway.
Executes GitHub read tools through the MCP gateway after permission checks.
